title: Covid Tracker
oneLiner: Web app for tracking COVID-19 cases with authentication

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Tracking COVID-19 data securely required controlled access and structured data management.

myRole.heading: Role
myRole.description: Built the application end-to-end, implementing authentication and managing frontend-backend integration.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Developed a web app with authenticated access, enabling users to track and manage COVID-19 case data securely.

impact.heading: Impact
impact.description: Provided a simple and secure interface for tracking case data with protected access and structured workflows.
